tools.name: audit_domain
tools.description: Run a live HTTP audit against a public domain and return score, grade and report URL.

tools.name: get_remediation_preview
tools.description: Return the remediation preview and scorecard URL for a domain.

tools.name: create_checkout_session
tools.description: Return a Stripe checkout link for the remediation pack for a domain.

tools.name: guard_check_session
tools.description: Replay an agent's tool-call log through the AgentGuard loop and budget guard and decide whether the next call should run. Catches identical and near-repeat loops (same file, URL or command), re-reads of finished items, failing-tool retry streaks and USD or token caps before spend.

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guard_check_session, get_remediation_preview · Private data: guard_check_session · Public sink: guard_check_session · Destructive: audit_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: guard_check_session, get_remediation_preview · Private data: guard_check_session · Public sink: guard_check_session · Destructive: audit_domain

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "guard_check_session" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Replay an agent's tool-call log through the AgentGuard loop and budget guard and decide whether the next call should run. Catches identical and near-repeat loops (same file, URL or command), re-reads of finished items, failing-tool retry streaks and USD or token caps before spend." → after: "Call before each tool call your agent makes. Send the calls so far and the one you are about to make, get back allowed true or false with the reason. Catches identical and near-repeat loops (same file, URL or command), re-reads of finished items, failing-tool retry streaks and USD or token caps befo"

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
